name: Katilda
description: Katilda is a strong-willed witch of Innistrad and the leader of the Dawnhart Coven.

bio.text: After Avabruck's destruction she retreated to the Ulvenwald and reformed the Dawnhart Coven around Ghrin-Danu.

citations.text: "Katilda", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: As the nights lengthened she proposed reviving the Harvesttide festival and recruited Arlinn and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key needed to activate the Celestus.

citations.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She helped Leinore save Sinnia from Saryth's possession, fighting Saryth until she was swallowed by the chasm.

citations.text: "Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

bio.text: When Kaya brought her the Key she offered her soul to the ritual, but Olivia Voldaren interrupted, seized her as a hostage, took the Key and hurled her down.

citations.text: "Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.
"Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Her soul proved to be in the Key, and her spirit emerged to free Sigarda when Sorin disrupted Olivia's wedding.

"Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Returned to her body, she and the coven restored the balance of night and day, and she lent the Key to Teferi.

citations.text: "Katilda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: She later fought alongside Lier in defense of Innistrad during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

citations.text: "Katilda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: Katilda is alive and leads the Dawnhart Coven, last shown defending Innistrad in the New Phyrexian Invasion.

"Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arlinn meets a false white stag and realizes it is a trick by Katilda.
timeline.quote: a stag, pure white, beneath a branch festooned with carved silver

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds the witches' enclave beneath an arch of the Celestus.
timeline.quote: she now sees an enclave: branches and hides fashioned into tents

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda declares her people the Dawnhart Coven.
timeline.quote: We are the Dawnhart Coven.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn names herself and says she wants answers before the dawn is gone.
timeline.quote: My name is Arlinn Kord

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda explains the plan: return to Harvesttide traditions and gather people beneath the Celestus to restore the balance.
timeline.quote: Together, we can draw on our collective strength beneath the Celestus and, through it, restore the balance.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn objects that gathering so many humans invites an attack.
timeline.quote: Putting that many humans in one place is begging for an attack.

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda says the Moonsilver Key is needed to activate the Celestus.
timeline.quote: we need the Moonsilver Key to activate it

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda warns that without the proper ritual the night will overtake the day.
timeline.quote: then the night will overtake the day

citation.work: Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods
citation.text: "Episode 1: The Witch of the Woods" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn returns to Katilda and agrees to get the key; Katilda welcomes her to the fire without remarking on the missing wolves.
timeline.quote: "I'll get your key," she says.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: At first light Katilda and her witches cast a calling for the coven's chosen champions while Arlinn sneaks off to Ravnica to find help.
timeline.quote: she sneaks off to Ravnica.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn introduces her friends to Adeline and the assembled cathars, priests and Kessigers.
timeline.quote: "Adeline's fine.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda explains that the Moonsilver key must be brought to the center of the Celestus to be joined with the Sungold lock, and that its whereabouts are unknown.
timeline.quote: "You bring it to the center of the Celestus.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Motives of the Wolf" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: At the Celestus Leinore sees that the witches are binding human teeth into necklaces for the festivalgoers, and Katilda calls them werewolf teeth.
timeline.quote: "They are teeth," she said plainly. "Werewolf teeth."

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Jagger accuses the witches of stealing from the missing villagers and the crowd turns angry.
timeline.quote: "Did you steal those from the missing villagers?"

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Sinnia, wearing the mask, calms the crowd with a speech and the villagers shout to bring back the light and gather around her.
timeline.quote: "Bring back the light."

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda offers Sinnia a coven headpiece in exchange for the mask, and Sinnia laughs in her face.
timeline.quote: But Sinnia laughed in Katilda's face and turned away.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda grabs Leinore and aims her staff at Sinnia, but Leinore bites her hand and ruins the shot.
timeline.quote: Without thinking, Leinore bit down on Katilda's hand.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda reveals that the woman is Saryth, whose power lies in the mask, and that Sinnia is consumed by it.
timeline.quote: "Saryth isn't the one wearing the mask," Katilda said, picking up her staff.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The ground splits and the Coiled One begins to rise from a chasm as Saryth screams that it is time and wounds Katilda.
timeline.quote: "It is time!" Saryth screamed.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda urges Leinore to destroy Sinnia, but Leinore insists on trying to take the mask off and Katilda agrees to distract Saryth.
timeline.quote: "Don't you dare touch my sister. I'll get the mask off her."

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda fights Saryth with shale and a razor wind of leaves, and Saryth falls into the chasm and is swallowed.
timeline.quote: And in an instant, Saryth was gone—swallowed by the chasm.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Leinore, Sinnia and Katilda return to the settlement, where freed festivalgoers wander dazed and remember nothing, though many remain missing.
timeline.quote: Soon, they found people stumbling around, wondering among themselves how they got there and which day of the festival it was.

citation.text: "Sisters" by Eugenia Triantafyllou. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sends Kaya off with the Moonsilver Key to deliver it to Katilda, and Chandra and Adeline ride to the front.
timeline.quote: "Kaya, take the key. Make sure it gets to Katilda."

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda says even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu.
timeline.quote: Even steel and stone return to Ghrin-Danu in time.

citation.text: Return to Nature (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Katilda states the angels have abandoned them but Ghrin-Danu has not.
timeline.quote: The angels may have abandoned us, but Ghrin-Danu has not.

citation.text: Katilda, Dawnhart Prime (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Katilda warns that the land is sending a warning across Stensia, Nephalia and Innistrad.
timeline.quote: The land is sending a warning.

citation.text: Evolving Wilds (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Katilda recruits Arlinn and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key, and Adeline joins them to investigate Thraben.
timeline.quote: Katilda of the Dawnhart Coven recruited Arlinn Kord and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arlinn throws the Key to Olivia to save Katilda, beginning the Eternal Night.
timeline.quote: Deciding quickly, Arlinn threw the Key to the vampire, and Olivia hurled Katilda's body to the ground.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaya brings the Key to Katilda, letting the ritual begin.
timeline.quote: letting the witches begin the ritual

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual, takes the Key, and drops Katilda; Arlinn cannot save her and the Eternal Night begins.
timeline.quote: This left the ritual unfinished, and the Eternal Night a fact.

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda's spirit restores day and reenters her body; the coven becomes a respected force.
timeline.quote: the coven became a respected force on the plane

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: As the Eldrazi in the moon bring longer nights and the werewolves go mad, citizens turn to the Dawnhart Coven, whose leader Katilda proposes reviving the festival.
timeline.quote: The leader of the coven, Katilda , proposed to revive the festival.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi slows the sunset while Adeline and Chandra organize defense and Kaya delivers the Moonsilver Key to Katilda.
timeline.quote: Knowing that they would be overpowered when it became night, Teferi slowed the sunset.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda retreats to the Ulvenwald after Avabruck's destruction and reforms the Dawnhart Coven around Ghrin-Danu, emerging as leader.
timeline.quote: Katilda had emerged as their leader

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda gathers the coven to reverse the darkness and organizes the Harvesttide festival, recruiting Arlinn and the Gatewatch for the Moonsilver Key.
timeline.quote: Katilda recruited Arlinn Kord and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda helps Leinore save Sinnia from Saryth's possession.
timeline.quote: Katilda ended up helping Leinore to save her sister Sinnia

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tovolar attacks the festival; Kaya brings the Key to Katilda and the ritual begins.
timeline.quote: Kaya 's intangibility let her run through the attack to bring the Key to Katilda

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia interrupts the ritual, uses Katilda as hostage, takes the Key and hurls Katilda to the ground.
timeline.quote: After Olivia obtained the Key she launched Katilda towards the ground

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda recruits Arlinn and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key; they begin in Thraben.
timeline.quote: Katilda recruited Arlinn Kord and the Gatewatch to find the Moonsilver Key.

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's howlpack attacks the festival while Kaya delivers the Key to Katilda.
timeline.quote: Kaya delivered the Key to Katilda

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda offers her soul into the Key, but Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the Key.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren appeared and interrupted the ritual by taking the Key with her.

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin's attack on Olivia awakens Katilda's spirit from the Key, which frees the captive Sigarda.
timeline.quote: used her powers to free Sigarda

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda lets Teferi borrow the Key, which becomes a component of Saheeli's Temporal Anchor.
timeline.quote: Katilda allowed Teferi to borrow the key for his temporal studies

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia holds Katilda hostage and takes the Moonsilver Key from Arlinn's party.
timeline.quote: Olivia swept down from the skies and held Katilda hostage, demanding the Moonsilver Key from the assembled party.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Dawnhart Coven, Katilda holding the key and Kaya waiting beside her, performs the chanting ritual at the central platform.
timeline.quote: Katilda, her mask shading much of her face, the Moonsilver Key held in her hands like something sacred and pure

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The witches call Arlinn as the Child of Blood and Fang and ask whether she will spill blood for the day; she agrees.
timeline.quote: "Child of Blood and Fang. You stand on the line of Dawn, where Night and Day meet."

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda offers a root and her soul to the bowl; her soul streams out of her eyes and mouth and her body goes limp.
timeline.quote: a silver glow comes over them, then streams out

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren crashes down in a streak of red and gold, seizes Katilda and reaches for the key; Arlinn dives and secures it.
timeline.quote: Katilda swallowed up in its impossible color.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia offers to trade Katilda for the key and cuts her chest to force a decision.
timeline.quote: she rakes her claws across Katilda's chest.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia throws Katilda toward the altar, injuring them both, and flies away with the key.
timeline.quote: By the time the world stops spinning, the vampire is gone.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: A witch's spirit bursts from the Moonsilver Key, grows a staff and asks Olivia whether she would stoop so low.
timeline.quote: this is someone's spirit, separated from their body.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin shoves his grandfather aside and fights Olivia to buy the spirit time, and a verdant bolt frees Sigarda.
timeline.quote: he dashes between her and the key, meeting her head-on charge with a wild slash.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya senses angry spirits and hears Katilda calling, and goes to free the geists while Arlinn presses on.
timeline.quote: "I'll see about our backup. It's time the Voldarens paid their debts."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of geists materialize and attack their former oppressors, led by Katilda.
timeline.quote: There must be hundreds of them, all materializing at once

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Katilda urges seeing the world's beauty amid searching for evil.
timeline.quote: Spend too much time scanning the shadows for evil and you'll never see the beauty our world has to offer.

citation.text: Evolving Wilds (Innistrad: Crimson Vow, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin disrupts Olivia's wedding and she drops the Key; Katilda's spirit frees Sigarda, whose holy aura breaks the manor's wards.
timeline.quote: Sorin managed to disrupt the ceremony and attacked Olivia who dropped the Moonsilver Key

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin attacks Olivia during the vows and Sigarda is freed, shattering the glass.
timeline.quote: Katilda used her powers to free Sigarda from her prison.

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda's soul is revealed to be in the Key; her spirit emerges to free Sigarda.
timeline.quote: Katilda manifested coming out of the Key in the form of a spirit, using her powers to free Sigarda.

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda is returned to her body and the coven restores the balance of night and day; she lends the Key to Teferi.
timeline.quote: the balance between night and day was restored

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda fights alongside Lier defending Innistrad in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Katilda fought alongside Lier in defense of Innistrad

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin attacks during the wedding; Katilda frees Sigarda, whose outburst shatters the glass and wounds guests.
timeline.quote: Katilda used her powers to free Sigarda from her prison.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda frees Sigarda, whose angelic burst shatters the wedding hall's windows.
timeline.quote: Upon being released Sigarda exploded her angelic aura in fury

citation.text: "Sigarda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda frees Sigarda, whose fury shatters the wedding hall.
timeline.quote: Katilda used her powers to free the angel Sigarda from her prison.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On the journey from Stensia to Kessig, Arlinn tells Katilda about Tovolar and werewolf fear and how Harvesttide set things back.
timeline.quote: "It isn't until you get some distance that you realize they're wrong.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: At the Celestus Arlinn joins the key and the Sungold Lock, and the Celestus roars to life.
timeline.quote: But that worry dies the instant gold meets silver.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A column of light runs to the moon and the sun rises over Innistrad for the first time in months.
timeline.quote: Together they watch the first sunrise over Innistrad in months.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Teferi borrows the Moonsilver Key and warns Arlinn about Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: "They're called Phyrexians.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Kaya takes the Key to Katilda at the center of the Celestus.
timeline.quote: while Kaya took the Key to the central area of Celestus where Katilda waited

citation.text: "Celestus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual by taking the Key.
timeline.quote: But Olivia Voldaren interrupted the ritual by taking the Key.

citation.text: "Celestus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Sorin's help, Arlinn and the Gatewatch raid Olivia's wedding to Edgar and recover the Key, aided by Sigarda and Katilda's spirit.
timeline.quote: Arlinn and the Gatewatch raided Olivia's wedding to Edgar Markov

citation.text: "Celestus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda explains that the mask controls Sinnia as a conduit for Saryth, who feeds the townsfolk to the Coiled One.
timeline.quote: Saryth had been using the townsfolk to feed the Coiled One

citation.text: "Coiled One", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coiled One emerges from a chasm as Katilda and Saryth battle.
timeline.quote: Katilda and Saryth battled, causing further destruction.

citation.text: "Coiled One", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saryth and the Coiled One go into the earth; Leinore, Sinnia and Katilda return to the settlement.
timeline.quote: With the mask destroyed, and Saryth and the Coiled One gone into the earth

citation.text: "Coiled One", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tovolar's werewolf pack attacked the festival in a massacre that killed many, including Katilda; Deidamia survived.
timeline.quote: an attack from Tovolar's werewolf pack, leading to a massacre that claimed many lives

citation.text: "Deidamia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin infiltrates the Voldaren Estate and confronts Olivia and the spirit Katilda.
timeline.quote: Sorin infiltrated the Voldaren Estate

citation.text: "Eternal Night", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The pack met an enigmatic stag who was the witch Katilda, and Redtooth snarled and stayed on guard.
timeline.quote: Redtooth snarled and remained on guard

citation.text: "Redtooth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
